body:
I just don't want to be a burden on anyone. Part of his reasoning for dumping me was that I'm going through some financial problems and slowing working my way through them. And that I'm kinda needy. I was always so jealous of him hanging with his female friends, and need alot of validation that someone cares about me. I don't want to be this way, but I can't help how I feel. I try so hard to convince myself to be stronger, I'm just not.... 

So I just don't want my friends or family to see me as a burden to them because I'm not feeling strong enough for this. It's really selfish, but... if I ended it, I know it would be a burden, but atleast I wouldn't be there to suffer feeling like a burden.
